sourceTitle: Some Old Time Beauties After Portraits by the English Masters, with Embellishment and Comment
description: "Some Old Time Beauties" by Thomson Willing is an illustrated collection focusing on historical portraits and the women they depict, crafted during the late 19th century. This work examines the lives and personalities of various beauties from English history, providing insights into their social status and influences.
